lines.text: Large crowds travel with Jesus, and He says anyone who does not hate even his own house cannot be His disciple.
Jesus says whoever does not carry his cross and follow Him cannot be His disciple.
A man who wants to build a tower should first count the cost, or everyone who sees will ridicule him.
A king with ten thousand men facing a king with five thousand sends a delegation to ask for terms of peace.
Anyone who does not give up everything cannot be Jesus' disciple, and salt that loses its savor is thrown out.
